disk_measurement_scope: retained_host_output_usage_after_execution is a recorded post-run apparent/allocated host-output measurement, not a peak; private work24GiB plus temporary1GiB were bounded tmpfs and are not inferred persistent host disk usage.
elapsed_measurement_scope: Recorded per-attempt scientific resource-controller elapsed wall time; summing sequential/overlapping cases does not represent campaign wall time or model effort.
exact_aggregate_memory_peak_unavailable: The recorded Linux5.15 kernel has no memory.peak file; sampled charged RAM is a lower bound, GNU time RSS is a separate rusage observation, reserved RAM is only a limit.

captured_process_usage.measurement: GNU time reported rusage maximum RSS; not an exact simultaneous aggregate cgroup memory peak

failed_attempts_separate.failure_cause: The initial historical auxiliary script was replayed at its later saved filename ancillary-initial.py instead of its actual original execution path ancillary.py; stdout and expected exit1 matched, while the literal stderr filename contract rejected.
